title: Quantum Technology and AI Are Set for Deep Integration! The First Xuanmi Quantum-Enhanced Large Model Officially Released in China

content_html:
The evolution of large language models is attempting to break the physical boundaries of pure classical computing. Recently, the Guoguang Quantum AI research team announced that they have introduced cutting-edge quantum technologies into the decision-making and reasoning core processes of large language models, and officially launched the new "Xuanmi" large model family for the scientific and academic fields.

In terms of core performance and application capabilities, the "Xuanmi" large model demonstrates unique competitive advantages. For vertical and specific tasks such as scientific popularization, task routing, and intelligent agent decision-making, this model not only has more stable and in-depth professional understanding capabilities compared to mainstream open-source models, but can also provide clearer task judgments in complex scenarios, while significantly shortening the overall decision path.

As a cross-industry technological exploration, the release of "Xuanmi" provides a new quantum-enhanced technical approach for improving efficiency and quality of large models in complex logical reasoning and specialized scientific computing.
